{{Quote|View of the Torch Nebula from the Nebula Hotel, Shownar|Captions on Oro Freatt's line of souvenir holocubes|<ref name="GG9" />}}
The '''Torch Nebula''', also known as the '''Torch sector''', was a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It formed a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that contained the [[Piluvia system/Legends|Piluvia system]] and was crossed by the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]] and [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].

By [[3640 BBY]], some [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] believed the Torch Nebula contained the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Lurker/Legends|lurker]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Pelles]], and by that [[Time/Legends|time]], the spectacular view of the nebula in the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] served as a major attraction for tourists.

==Description==
The Torch Nebula,<ref name="EAOC" /> also referred to as the Torch sector,<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> was an expansive [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]]<ref name="GG9" /> that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was composed of various [[Gas/Legends|gases]] and chemical elements related to the makeup of [[Star/Legends|stars]] and was considered a celestial oddity. The nebula dominated the [[Standard day/Legends|night]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] of the nearby [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar]], where it manifested as a spectacular display of [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] [[Color/Legends|blue]] and red lights.<ref name="GG9" />

[[File:Lurker.png|thumb|left|200px|Lurkers were believed by some biologists to be native to the Torch Nebula.]]
The Torch Nebula contained the [[Piluvia system/Legends|Piluvia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which shared its name with the phenomenon known as the [[Piluvian salamander-storm]].<ref name="Jedi Healer">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> At the edges of the nebula lay a [[Unidentified jungle world (Torch Nebula)|nameless jungle world]], which,<ref name="Codex" /> by approximately [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="date3640">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act III of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place between [[3641 BBY]] and [[3640 BBY]]. Since the Codex entry for [[Lurker/Legends|lurkers]] can only be discovered on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], which is visited by all classes in Act III, the information contained therein can be dated to some point by 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> was believed by [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] serving the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to be the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] known as [[Lurker/Legends|lurkers]].<ref name="Codex" />

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Torch Nebula constituted a regional [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" /> and was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Pelles]].<ref name="GG9" /> The nebula bordered the Parmic sector [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] and the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] [[spinward]] and Rimward, while sharing the [[trailing]] border with the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]].<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" /> The [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] passed through the sector,<ref name="Llanic Spice Run" /> as did a segment of the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]].<ref name="Five Veils" />

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="GG9 date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those two battles to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively, while establishing the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] as the final event before the beginning of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Moff Pelles wished for a higher level of security in the Torch Nebula given that the vital Llanic [[Spice/Legends|Spice]] Run crossed the sector's borders. Pelles voiced those concerns in the form of criticism aimed at Moff [[Abran Balfour/Legends|Abran Balfour]] and his lack of involvement in governing the Parmic sector, which contained the endpoint of the Llanic Spice Run.<ref name="GG9" />

[[File:Shownar.png|thumb|right|210px|The Torch Nebula was a spectacular sight in the sky of Shownar.]]
The Torch Nebula was considered to be the most impressive sight for tourists on Shownar during that time, with the planet's renowned [[Nebula Hotel]] offering a breathtaking view of the celestial phenomenon. The remarkable imagery caused by the nebula in Shownar's skies was made famous by a highly popular line of souvenir [[Holocube/Legends|holocubes]] created by Shownar's preeminent businessman, [[Oro Freatt]].<ref name="GG9" />

[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Callow Batta]], a former [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of governmental and [[Politics/Legends|political]] history at the [[University of Sanbra]] who had turned to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] after he had been fired by Imperial authorities, led a successful raid on a [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] within the Torch Nebula<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> at some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Date Batta">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Furthermore, ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' states that [[Callow Batta]] had become a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] "about a year ago," placing the start of his criminal activities at no earlier than [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Torch Nebula was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" /> The nebula was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in [https://web.archive.org/web/20180325111127/https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors], a feature of<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" /> the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The map placed it in grid squares P-18 and P-19.<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" />

The [[1995]] ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' introduced the "Torch sector."<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> Given that "The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors" depicts the Torch Nebula as a sector,<ref name="EAOC Outer Rim" /> this article assumes that the two terms are synonymous.
